g.text: Store n/Changed and p/-5 only in local fields.
The original recipe has not been read or changed.
parseEditRecipe catches the error and wraps it in
MishMashException, retaining the cause and edit usage.
The omitted calorie field is condensed here.
executeCommand returns to the command-reading loop.
The next command follows the normal successful parsing flow.
No RecipeChanges, EditRecipeCommand, or replacement Recipe is created for the rejected input.
The valid n/Changed field is not applied. Recipes, plans, and groceries remain unchanged.
